name: RunComfy
original_description:
Run ComfyUI workflows on a cloud GPU, generate and edit AI images and videos, and train custom LoRA models with RunComfy in ChatGPT. Start with a workflow JSON, a text prompt, an image, or your own training dataset.
With RunComfy, you can:
• Run your ComfyUI workflows in the cloud. Review inputs, adjust supported settings for each run, and create content without managing a local GPU setup.
• Generate and edit AI images from a text prompt or your own photos with a range of image models. Create product visuals, explore different styles, and bring creative concepts to life.
• Create AI videos from text, images and reference clips with a range of video models. Use reference images, video and audio to explore different looks and turn creative ideas into motion.
• Make finished marketing and content pieces with guided workflows: product review, unboxing and try-on videos, static ads from product research, new video ads from a reference ad, headline tests, ad resizing and narrated explainers.
• Train custom LoRA models with your own images and captions. Prepare datasets, start training jobs, and follow their progress.
• Track your workflow runs, image and video generations, and training jobs. Retrieve generated media and available training files when they're ready.
Connect your RunComfy account to get started.
